column1: # SingNet frozen split manifest (MASTER_PLAN §4.2) - names only
# 86 train / 14 valid / 50 test (the frozen protocol shared by all directions).
# VALIDATION (14): verbatim from the official sigsep source
#   (field: validation_tracks). This is the exact split Open-Unmix trains against.
# TRAIN (86) and TEST (50): the full MUSDB18 track-name list is NOT published in
# any sigsep repo file (track names are the dataset filenames
# committed anywhere for licensing reasons). The rows below are therefore
# fix the counts (86/50) and split flags. At data-prep time
# scans the decoded MUSDB18 folders and rewrites these rows with the real track
# names (14 valid = the names above must all appear in the 100-track train
# folder; the remaining 86 -> train; the 50 test-folder tracks -> test)
# fails loud on any count or valid-name mismatch. Training never loads a 'test'
Clara Berry And Wooldog - Waltz For My Victims
Patrick Talbot - A Reason To Leave
